 Megan Fox wants ex MGK to 'find happiness' in new relationship with Dakota Johnson
 "She doesn’t want him back"
 © Lester Cohen 
 Rebecah Jacobs Writer OCTOBER 24, 2026 2:11 PM EDT OCT 24, 2026, 2:11 PM EDT 
 Megan Fox is reportedly happy that her former fiancé, Machine Gun Kelly , is exploring a new romance with actress Dakota Johnson.
 According to a source who spoke exclusively to Page Six, Fox is not bothered by the possibility of her ex moving on. Instead, she is said to feel relieved that he may be starting a new chapter in his love life.
 “Megan isn’t just unbothered by MGK dating Dakota — she’s actually relieved he’s moving on,” the insider told the outlet.
 The source added that Fox genuinely hopes the musician finds happiness with someone else, explaining that she considers their relationship firmly in the past. She reportedly has no desire to rekindle their romance or repeatedly revisit what happened between them.
 The comments followed a report from TMZ on Thursday stating that Fox, 40, was unconcerned about the developing connection between her former fiancé and Johnson, 37, and did not intend to interfere in his personal life.
 Fox and MGK Continue to Co-Parent Their Daughter
 Although their romantic relationship has ended, Fox and Machine Gun Kelly, 36, whose real name is Colson Baker, continue to share a connection through their daughter, Saga Blade, whom they welcomed in March 2025.
 According to the source, the former couple has maintained a positive co-parenting relationship since their split.
 © Getty NEW YORK, NEW YORK - JUNE 27: Machine Gun Kelly and Megan Fox go back to their hotel on June 27, 2022 in New York City. (Photo by Jackson Lee/GC Images) 
 “They have a daughter together, so obviously he’s always going to be part of her life, and they have a good co-parenting relationship,” the insider explained.
 However, the source emphasized that Fox wants their relationship to remain focused on raising their child rather than revisiting their romantic past.
 She reportedly hopes they can continue being effective parents while maintaining clear boundaries about their relationship status.
 MGK's Flirty Instagram Comments Were Reportedly a Factor
 The insider also suggested that Fox's reported sense of relief may be connected to the musician's behavior following their breakup.
 In March, MGK attracted attention after leaving a flirtatious comment on a series of revealing Instagram photos shared by Fox when she returned to the social media platform.
 “Stoked i have your phone number,” the singer wrote beneath the pictures.
 According to the source, the public interaction contributed to the impression that MGK was still trying to get Fox's attention despite their separation.
 © Emma McIntyre Machine Gun Kelly and Megan Fox 
 “Even after they broke up, he was still leaving those flirty comments on her Instagram, and it felt like he was trying to get her attention,” the insider said.
 From Fox's reported perspective, the relationship had already run its course, and she was ready to move forward without the uncertainty of continued romantic overtures.
 The source explained that Fox believes they gave their relationship a chance, but it ultimately did not work out. She reportedly does not want to continue experiencing an emotional back-and-forth with her former partner.
 Fox Reportedly Hopes Things Work Out Between MGK and Dakota Johnson
 With MGK now spending time with Johnson, Fox reportedly hopes his romantic attention will shift toward his new connection.
 The insider said Fox has no personal issue with the Fifty Shades of Grey actress and would genuinely like to see the pair develop a successful relationship.
 Rather than viewing Johnson as a rival, Fox reportedly sees the potential romance as an opportunity for everyone involved to move forward.
 © Getty Dakota Johnson, MGK 
 The source explained that Fox wants MGK to be happy with someone else, allowing her to concentrate on her own life while keeping their co-parenting arrangement free from unnecessary romantic complications.
 According to the insider, if MGK is content with Johnson and committed to building a relationship with her, that would be an ideal outcome for Fox.
 These descriptions of Fox's feelings come from unnamed sources cited by the media outlets and have not been independently confirmed by Fox herself.
 Fox and MGK Ended Their Engagement in 2024
 Fox and MGK ended their relationship in 2024 while the actress was pregnant with their first child together.
 Their breakup marked the end of a high-profile romance that had attracted considerable public attention throughout their time together.
 © Getty NEW YORK, NY - SEPTEMBER 13: Dakota Johnson attends day 15 of the 2026 US Open Tennis Championships on September 13, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by XNY/Star Max/GC Images) 
 Despite their separation, the two remain connected through their daughter and continue to navigate parenthood together.
 MGK and Dakota Johnson Spark Romance Rumors in New York
 Meanwhile, speculation about a possible relationship between MGK and Johnson began in September after the pair were reportedly seen spending time together in New York City.
 According to an exclusive report from Page Six, the two spent private time at a mutual friend Taylor Swift's apartment in Tribeca before heading to the restaurant Estela for dinner.
 A source familiar with the outing told the publication that there was “definitely chemistry” between them, although their connection was still in its early stages.
 Neither the reported chemistry nor the pair's outings necessarily confirms the status of their relationship.
 For now, the reported developments suggest that MGK may be exploring a new romantic chapter, while Fox is said to be focused on moving forward and maintaining a stable co-parenting relationship with her former fiancé.
